question: Who among the following wrote the non-fiction ‘The Paradoxical Prime Minister: Narendra Modi and His India’?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Shashi Tharoor__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Paradoxical Prime Minister:**

 
 
• **The Paradoxical Prime Minister: Narendra Modi And His India is a Non-fiction book written by senior Indian National Congress parliamentarian Shashi Tharoor. Hence option 1 is correct.**
 
• The book talks about prime minister **Narendra Modi's life and his time**.
 
• It is divided into five sections comprising **50 chapters**.
 
• It will release on **26th October 2018.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shashi Tharoor:**

 
 
• He is an Indian** former international diplomat, politician, writer, and public intellectual** who has been serving as a **Member of Parliament, Lok Sabha from Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, since 2009.**
 
• He was formerly **Under-Secretary-General of the United Nations** and ran for the post of **Secretary-General in 2006.**
